title: A design for more than one game
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead, with Blitzwing
body: A short design proposes how the arena grows from tanks to racing and other training setups. Every game plugs into the same engine interface. A small reward hook and a fixed-size number view let standard training tools use any game. Tanks refit first with no change to any recorded match, and racing is game two.
next: Nye's call on the open questions, then a small first milestone with unchanged hashes.
